test: fetch all four pinned assets into an initially empty standalone directory, then run --check

network_findings.confirmed: Python default User-Agent returned HTTP 403; Mozilla/5.0 returned HTTP 200 and the pinned SHA256.

network_findings.observed_issue: An earlier download during packaging had a SHA256 mismatch.
network_findings.follow_up: Independent downloads with both default and Mozilla/5.0 User-Agents returned HTTP 200, 2781508 bytes, and the same pinned SHA256.
network_findings.cause: Not determined; the mismatch was not reproduced. No claim that User-Agent alone caused it.

fixes: Use browser-compatible User-Agent only for cdn.arducam.com; retain urllib default requests for the other vendors.
Require a full HTTP 200 response, check Content-Length when present, and always verify the original pinned SHA256 before atomically installing a file.
At most three attempts for transient network failures, incomplete responses, or hash mismatches; retries request cache revalidation and never change the expected hash.
Permanent HTTP errors such as 403 fail without repeated requests. Failed temporary downloads are removed; existing mismatched local assets are preserved and rejected.
